acceptance_defined: 2026-11-06 before candidate implementation or numerical candidate comparison; original default physical parameters and independently derived cold-start/TR error bound
reference_platform: MATLAB R2025a Update 1 / Simulink / Simscape / Simscape Electrical
known_difference: Same original eight-block physical network without any transmission line section. Existing transformers combine two positive winding resistances on primary via the exact ideal current ratio because leakage/magnetizing/core-loss branches are excluded. Two wye neutrals remain floating. A case-local mean-voltage constraint represents the delta vector-triangle center; no physical grounding or leakage resistor is added. Source X/R-derived R/L and zero current initialization retained. Native source I/IL are entering the source, so normalized supply current is their negative. Reference solver independently tightened/refined; absolute times preserved, no shift, phase or amplitude fit. This does not validate saturation, zero-sequence faults or other connection groups.

internal_acceptance.independent_solution: Ls*di/dt+(Rs+.0676+169000)*i = 13000*sin(2*pi*60*t+phi), phi=[0,-120,+120]deg, i(0)=0. Exact sin+exp solution and fixed AB/BC/CA algebra reconstruct all ports and losses; no MNA reuse or fitted parameters.
internal_acceptance.reference_self_refinement: ode15s baseline RelTol1e-9 AbsTol1e-11 MaxStep25us; refined RelTol1e-10 AbsTol1e-12 MaxStep12.5us; both InitialStep1e-10s; all 19 signals in both fixed windows must differ by less than one tenth each formal absolute limit and one tenth each NRMSE limit
required_checks: actual three source currents initially zero; finite initial voltages consistent with source emf
same two floating wye neutrals and delta AB/BC/CA pairing
delta center mean voltage zero and total reference current zero; reference is not physical return path
winding versus line current C-transpose mapping and signed source supply current
positive copper/source/load losses and exact port power balance
total source work = source L energy + all resistor losses over whole startup/steady waveform
full transient comparison with independent sin+exp solution, plus TR startup refinement
steady phase shift at intermediate bus and cancellation at load; load is fixed impedance, not constant power
internal_acceptance.phase_reference: Corresponding v:lv:a,b,c at Tup primary terminal, not internal source emf
internal_acceptance.energy_balance_relative_denominator: max(abs(total source work), abs(total integrated resistor loss), 1e-12 J); whole interval
internal_acceptance.trapezoidal_discrete_energy_identity: Each step: delta(.5*Ls*sum(i^2)) = h*(mean_endpoint_emf dot mean_endpoint_i - (Rs+.0676+169000)*sum(mean_endpoint_i^2)); physical trapezoidal integration of instantaneous power checked separately
internal_acceptance.delta_reference_current_definition: i:DeltaCenter is total lambda; each nodal reference current lambda/3; lambda must be zero for the isolated island

signal_name_correction: Before candidate exists or is run: use native ThreePhaseTransformer node fields v:lv:a/hv:a/load:a rather than underscore aliases; physics, windows and numerical limits unchanged.
